structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son or the bank. Harel's page only shows funds, with fees of about half a percent a year, and nothing that says it is safe like a deposit. The "כספי (שקלי)" one shows 4.25%, but I don't know what it is.

stuck.why: English letters 'S&P 500' and 'עוקב מדד' right at the start made me feel it's not for me
Too many numbers and coloured rings, I got anxious; many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return and I didn't understand why
Says there are extra costs 'שלא מופיעות כאן' — so what do I actually pay?
Everything is closed; I didn't know which one to open

used: Fee summary 'דמי ניהול מההיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%'
Track names in the right column of the table
Sentence that past return doesn't say what will happen

English and jargon at the top ('S&P 500', 'עוקב מדד') make it feel like it's for investors, not for me
